scope: Separate source-only obligation ledger; never supplied to requirement_routes.py as native rule IDs.

requirements: independently accepted complete native/visual evidence under routes.json
independent source review passing every must obligation in this ledger with original production file/line evidence
separate successful minimum-iOS API module and unchanged-caller typecheck

obligations.clause: Source-only: declare and apply the original typed font, color and spacing values.
obligations.runtime_limit: Source declarations do not establish computed fonts, colors, effective padding, rendering, or their runtime use. Independent native/pixel/visual evidence remains separately required.

obligations.clause: Source-only: the open-to-closed notes Button transition hides the body and emits exactly one notes:<current requestID>:closed event.
obligations.runtime_limit: Closing notes is not dispatched by the selected runtime route. Source review cannot establish an actual callback, native activation, interval, or closed-state rendering after this transition.

obligations.clause: Source-only: changing an unsent delegate selection back to self sets the self selection, hides acknowledgment, makes confirmation valid, and emits exactly one collector:<current requestID>:self event.
obligations.runtime_limit: The route starts with self selected but never activates self after choosing delegate. Initial/reset self facts do not prove the self-choice callback branch.

obligations.clause: Source-only: a real true-to-false acknowledgment toggle emits exactly one ack:<current requestID>:false event and makes unsubmitted delegate confirmation invalid.
obligations.runtime_limit: Only false-to-true acknowledgment is dispatched. Its callback and initial false value do not prove true-to-false activation or its callback interval.

obligations.clause: Source-only: an enabled self-collection confirmation emits exactly one submit:<current requestID>:self event and applies the original submitted-state behavior.
obligations.runtime_limit: Runtime confirmation is exercised only for delegate. Self primary-enabled facts do not prove an actual self submission callback or its resulting rendering.

obligations.clause: Source-only: reselecting the already selected collector leaves selection unchanged and emits no collector event, consistent with the original different-collector requirement.
obligations.runtime_limit: No same-choice activation is dispatched; an empty callback interval is not inferred from the selected route.

obligations.clause: Source-only: disabled choice, acknowledgment and confirmation controls cannot invoke their business callbacks; guards preserve the original submitted and invalid-state behavior.
obligations.runtime_limit: Runtime enabled/disabled native facts are asserted, but disabled controls are not activated and no runtime no-callback verdict is claimed.

obligations.clause: Source-only preliminary API review followed by the separately required minimum-target compiler check.
obligations.runtime_limit: No compiler or SDK is executed by this design. Neither source review nor later typechecking proves iOS14 runtime rendering.
